brief.usage:
Usage:
  node brief.mjs <template> --project <docDir> [--lang en|fr] [--var key=value]… [--output <file>]
  node brief.mjs <template> --project <docDir> --vars
  node brief.mjs <template> --project <docDir> --estimate [--var key=value]…
  node brief.mjs --list [--lang en|fr]
brief.notABrief_todo: create the consolidation file with: node consolidation.mjs init --project <docDir> --codes a,b,c
brief.unfilled_todo: add {vars} (or extra.briefs.<key> in doc.config.mjs), then run again
brief.launch: → launch it with the agent type {agent} and the model {model}, the brief's full text as the prompt (the common part first: every agent of the wave after the first reads it from the prompt cache)
brief.noAgent: → this brief template declares no agent type (add a front matter line "agent: <type>")
brief.estimateNoAgent: Estimate for {template} — this brief declares no agent type
brief.estimateOutputNone: output: 0 tokens (no page list to estimate from: {reason})
brief.estimateOutputNone_noPages: the "pages" placeholder is empty or not used by this template
brief.estimateOutputSize: output: {tokens} tokens (a subject of size {size}, the brief's output-tokens)
brief.estimateOutputNone_noSize: this brief's output depends on the size of its subject: --var size=S|M|L
brief.estimateNoCost: cost:   not estimated (set llm.prices.{model} in doc.config.mjs)
brief.appDirDerived: appDir is not configured (app.dir in doc.config.mjs): {dir} is assumed ({how})
brief.appDirDerived_todo: check it: set app.dir in doc.config.mjs (the application root, relative to the documentation folder), or pass --var appDir=<folder>
brief.how_parent: two levels above the documentation folder
brief.appDirMissing_todo: fix app.dir in doc.config.mjs, or pass --var appDir=<folder>
brief.separateFront: the coverage source ({source}) is in a separate front end ({front}): the inventory of routes only sees the front end
brief.separateFront_todo: the briefs point at {dir}: make sure the agents also read the back end there (API, permissions, writes while rendering)

usage.usage:
Usage:
  node usage.mjs log --brief <name> --agent <type> --model <model> --tokens <n> [--tools <n>]
                     [--duration <ms>] [--pages a,b] [--phase <name>] [--project <docDir>]
  node usage.mjs report [--json] [--project <docDir>]
  node usage.mjs scan --transcripts <folder> [--project <docDir>]
usage.noAction: give one of: log, report, scan
usage.badTokens: --tokens must be a non-negative integer, not {value}
usage.badTokens_todo: pass the total tokens Claude Code reported for this agent
usage.transcriptsMissing_todo: pass the folder that holds Claude Code's .jsonl transcripts
usage.scanned: ✔ scanned {files} transcript file(s), {lines} usage line(s): {tokens} tokens
usage.scannedNone: scanned {files} transcript file(s): no message.usage found
usage.noPages: No page tokens to report (no --pages was logged).
usage.costApprox: {model}: {cost} {currency} (from {n} logged token(s), approximate: no input/output split)
usage.costNone: not estimated: set llm.prices in doc.config.mjs
usage.unpriced: {tokens} scanned token(s) have no model tag and are not priced
usage.gapNone: no brief template or no logged pages to compare against

consolidation.usage:
Usage:
  node consolidation.mjs init --project <docDir> --codes a,b,c [--topic "…"] [--lang en|fr] [--output <file>] [--force]
  node consolidation.mjs duplicates --project <docDir> [--file <file>] [--findings <page-id>] [--no-findings] [--json]
consolidation.codesMissing_todo: example: --codes u1,u2,cf or --codes "ord=Journey of an order,inv=Journey of an invoice"
consolidation.codeInvalid_todo: letters, digits, dash or underscore (u1, ord, a2…)
consolidation.templateMarkers: the consolidation template lacks its section markers
consolidation.fileExists_todo: add --force to overwrite it, or --output <another file>
consolidation.unfilled_todo: complete doc.config.mjs (product.name…), then run again with --force
consolidation.createdNext: → paste the candidates, errors and terms of each report into it, then run "consolidation.mjs duplicates".
consolidation.fileMissing_todo: create it with "consolidation.mjs init", or pass --file <path>
consolidation.noCandidate_todo: each "## Title (code)" section needs a "### Candidate findings" sub-section with a numbered list
consolidation.existing: Lines already cited by an existing finding ({where}):
consolidation.noExisting: No existing finding ({where}) cites these lines.
consolidation.withoutRef: Candidates without a file:line reference (complete or check by hand): {list}
consolidation.next: → write the decisions under "Duplicates found", then launch findings-verification and page-corrections.

analysis.usage:
Usage:
  node analysis.mjs check [<feature>…] --project <docDir>
  node analysis.mjs digest <feature> --for use|product|admin|develop --project <docDir> [--output <file>]
  node analysis.mjs questions --project <docDir> [--output <file>]
  node analysis.mjs findings --project <docDir> [--json]
  node analysis.mjs depth --project <docDir> [--audit <file>] [--json]
analysis.noKit: the kit's engine cannot be reached (engine/, schemas/)
analysis.noKit_todo: run doc-kit skill install from the kit, or run the script from the kit's source tree
analysis.readerInvalid: --for "{value}": expected use, product, admin or develop
analysis.invalid_todo: node analysis.mjs check {feature} lists them; fix them, or have the analyst do it
analysis.noFinding: no candidate finding in the analyses
analysis.auditMissing_todo: run doc-kit audit first: it writes .doc-kit/audit.json
analysis.depthDone: ✔ nothing open in the feature sheets: the depth loop ends here
analysis.depthLeft: {n} gaps left to the product owner: node analysis.mjs questions
analysis.digest.title: digest for the {reader} space
analysis.digest.note: Made by scripts/analysis.mjs from the analysis of the feature: what its writer starts from. Each item as the analyst found it; “Unknown” is a question to keep open in the page, never to fill.
analysis.questions.title: Open questions
analysis.questions.intro: What the analysis of the code could not settle, feature by feature: to answer with the product owner, then in the feature sheets. Made by scripts/analysis.mjs questions.
analysis.questions.notCarried: {gap}: answered by the analysis, but still not in the sheet after two rounds
analysis.questions.none: None: every item of the analyses is settled.
analysis.problem.fileName: {file} holds the analysis of {feature}: the file is named after its feature
analysis.problem.rubric: {at}: "{rubric}" is not a rubric of its kind ({known})
analysis.problem.rubricMissing: {at}: required rubrics without an item: {rubrics} (an explicit unknown or n/a counts)
analysis.problem.proofNeeded: {at}: verified or deduced needs at least one proof
analysis.problem.textNeeded: {at}: verified or deduced needs its text
analysis.problem.questionNeeded: {at}: unknown needs the question to ask
analysis.problem.codeInText: {at}: "{token}" looks like code in a text for a reader without the code: move it to mechanism
analysis.problem.proofOutside: {at}: {file} is not inside the application folder (not read)
analysis.problem.proofMissing: {at}: {file} does not exist in the application folder
analysis.problem.proofRange: {at}: {file}:{line}-{end} is not a range of its {n} lines
analysis.problem.secret: {at}: a secret-like value ({kind}): an analysis never holds one — name it, then "(masked)"
analysis.skipped: {feature} is skipped: it does not follow the format
analysis.skippedSecret: {feature} is skipped: one of its texts holds a secret-like value
analysis.appDirDerived: app.dir is not set: the proofs are checked against {dir}, a folder guessed from the documentation's
analysis.appDirDerived_todo: set app.dir in doc.config.mjs to the application's root
